summary: No role cleared every hard gate on November 28. The sweep found no new senior AI engineering listing with published pay that meets the rule. Qonto republished its Senior AI Engineer requisition, already a near-miss here on November 11, with unchanged duties and still no published pay or office-day rule. Nebius posted a new remote-Europe GPU infrastructure role that is hardware diagnostics rather than AI-central work. Previously reported roles, including Inato's Senior AI Engineer (qualified on November 27) and Doctolib's Senior/Staff AI Engineer near-miss, are unchanged and stay in the archive rather than being repeated as today's picks.
coverage: Automated official-ATS sweep on November 28: 129 of 276 attempted Ashby, Lever and Greenhouse board aliases returned data, the same reach as November 27; many failed aliases are likely wrong board names, not evidence of no vacancies. Additional passes over other board names and over Ashby roles published since November 26 were diffed against the November 27 sweep. New or republished matches were Qonto's Senior AI Engineer, Nebius's GPU infrastructure role, a Doctolib AI engineering internship (wrong seniority) and several non-engineering or non-France roles. No web searches were used today. Coverage is bounded, not exhaustive.
criteria: Paris hybrid with explicit attendance, or fully remote explicitly allowing France-based applicants.
Senior/staff hands-on AI-central engineering; an AI employer, coding assistant use or AI product UI alone does not establish the required assignment.

Employer-published annual gross cash-base lower bound strictly above €100,000, or at least €80,000 with explicit equity. Use the lower bound; equity is not cash; packages, OTE, unlabelled pay ranges and estimates do not pass.
No unchanged prior selections. Requisition identity takes precedence over refreshed titles, URLs or timestamps; historical qualification is not current-live verification.
uncertainty: Sources checked November 28, 2026. Posting dates come from employer ATS metadata.
Qonto's and Nebius's missing salaries mean pay is unknown, not that it fails the threshold.
Qonto's re-listing was compared with the November 11 listing text recorded by this research; only company boilerplate changed.
Unchanged roles from earlier reports were not re-verified as live today; their archived entries record the dates they were checked.
Deduplication covered the accessible October 10 to November 27 reports and the supplied October 3/5 Escape history.
decision: No approval needed for this authorized daily website update. Zero roles qualified today, so no new pick is published; earlier picks remain in the archive with their original check dates. No applications or outreach were made.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.locationQuote: Official listing: location “Paris, France; Barcelona, Spain; Berlin, Germany; Madrid, Spain; Milan, Italy”, location type “Hybrid”. No office-day rule is published; the application form asks “What working arrangement are you ideally looking for? (we will discuss it during the hiring process)” and offers options including “an onsite role with the possibility of working 2 days / week remotely”.[1][2]

salary.quote: No salary is published on the listing or in the official Ashby job data. Qonto's careers page says “Your recruiter will discuss compensation early in the interview process” and offers ESOPs “for eligible roles”, which does not confirm equity for this role. Pay is unknown, not below the threshold.[1][3]

reasons: Not a new requisition: this site recorded the same Ashby requisition as a near-miss on November 11 (and it also appeared on October 17). The employer republished it on November 27; compared with the November 11 text, the duties and requirements are unchanged and only company boilerplate was added.[1]
Pay gate unverified: no employer-published salary or role-specific equity.[1][3]
Location gate unverified: Paris is listed and the role is marked hybrid, but attendance is left to the hiring process rather than published as a rule.[1][2]

AI centrality passes: the engineer builds agents that “take real actions for customers” and owns their evaluation and production monitoring. Seniority remains uncertain: the requirements accept products shipped “during an internship or as a side project” and offer hands-on coaching.[1]
The listing and application form loaded on the check date.[1][2]
jobs.product: Employer-stated: Qonto offers a business finance workspace with banking for small and medium businesses, and says it serves over 750,000 customers in 8 European countries. This role sits in the AI Products team and focuses on agent reliability: sizing evaluation to the risk of each action (“an agent making transfers is not a PR bot”), offline and online evaluation, production monitoring, and a self-service platform for other teams. The listed stack is Python with Pydantic-ai, models accessed through AWS, Grafana for usage and cost per sub-agent, and a self-hosted Braintrust instance for evaluation and monitoring.[1]
jobs.financials: Employer-stated in the listing: about 1,700 employees and “profitable since 2023”; these are company claims, not audited figures. Funding and revenue were not checked in this run because the role did not pass the pay and location gates.[1]

jobs.title: Senior AI Infrastructure Systems Engineer (R&D / GPU / AI)
jobs.locationQuote: Official listing: “Remote - Europe”. No list of eligible countries is published; the application form asks “Do you currently reside in the location specified for this role?”[4][5]

salary.quote: No salary or equity is published; the listing says only “Competitive compensation”. Pay is unknown, not below the threshold.[4]

reasons: AI centrality fails: the role diagnoses hardware and platform failures in GPU servers across Linux, PCIe, firmware, power and cooling. It supports AI infrastructure but building, evaluating, securing or operating AI/ML systems is not the primary duty.[4]
Pay gate unverified: only “Competitive compensation” is stated.[4]
Location gate unverified: “Remote - Europe” does not explicitly name France.[4]
New requisition first published November 27, 2026; the listing and its embedded application form loaded on the check date.[4][5]
jobs.product: Employer-stated: Nebius describes itself as a full-stack AI cloud platform for training and deploying models, listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam. No separate product source was read because the role failed the AI-central gate.[4]
jobs.financials: Employer-stated in the listing: a team of 1,500+ and a Nasdaq listing. Revenue and profitability were not checked in this run.[4]

evidence.label: [4] Official Nebius listing with embedded application form
evidence.quote: This is a senior systems engineering role focused on diagnosing and resolving complex hardware and platform failures in high-performance AI infrastructure.
